note: How trees and green are arranged in each region as seen from a plane (0 absent .. 3 dominant). Keyed by regional-character id. DeepSeek research with sources, 29 Oct 2026; checked by Claude (ids, value ranges, spot-checks).

id-bali.fieldEdges: checkerboard sawah bunds with coconut palms on every edge
id-bali.note: From the air Bali reads as a green rice ladder: subak-irrigated terraces climb every volcano flank, ribbed with coconut palms and dotted with temple banyans, while dark forest caps keep only the summits.

jp-honshu.fieldEdges: neat small rice paddies with concrete-banked ditches
jp-honshu.note: Forest rides the mid-slopes of every ridge while shrine woods hold town edges, leaving valley bottoms as an emerald patchwork of tiny rice paddies, concrete ditches and village groves.

fr-provence.fieldEdges: olive rows and dry-stone walls with cypresses at gateways
fr-provence.note: Pale limestone hills carry dark pine combes and maquis, every valley bottom is a lattice of vineyards, olive and orchard rows, and dry-stone terraces step the slopes near villages.

no-norway.fieldEdges: bare rock and stone-bar fence lines around mown stubble
no-norway.note: Almost everything between fjords is one unbroken spruce-pine-birch blanket; farms are brick-red clearings with hay grass and grey stone cairn walls, and the treeline snuffs out agriculture high and north.

ke-kenya.fieldEdges: red-earth tracks between tea blotches, maize strips and thorn pasture
ke-kenya.note: The Central Highlands contrast huge green tea blocks and coffee acreage with red savanna thornbush below, all cut by the Rift's stepped cliffs; eucalypt windbreaks ring every farm compound.

pe-andes.fieldEdges: dry stone terrace walls contouring every valley slope
pe-andes.note: A tan vertical world where green occurs only as contour terraces of potato and maize, gallery eucalyptus along streams and irrigated orchard strips in the valley bottoms.

gulf.fieldEdges: pivot circles and fenced sandy plots beside grey oil towns
gulf.note: Date-palm oasis groves irrigated and fenced are the only green blocks in a pale desert crossed by roads and oil facilities; modern farms show as pivot circles along the coasts (low confidence on the exact current farm footprint).

nl-netherlands.fieldEdges: tree-lined drainage ditches subdividing every polder
nl-netherlands.note: A lace of drainage ditches runs along tree lines between emerald cow meadows, with brick farm houses, occasional flower strips and small woods, and the bigger plantations keep to sandier ground.

us-new-england.fieldEdges: grey stone walls running inside woods
us-new-england.note: Unbroken oak-pine-maple cover is punctured only by dairy meadows, apple-orchard lattices and white steeple villages, with grey stone walls running through the woods.

jp-okinawa.fieldEdges: fenced sugarcane blocks on red soil beside turquoise reef flats
jp-okinawa.note: Sugarcane grounds on bright-red coral soil, a fukugi hedge stacked around each village and pineapple plots inland; forest stays only small and scattered on ridges.

jp-hokkaido.fieldEdges: straight birch-row shelterbelts dividing big rectangular fields
jp-hokkaido.note: Rectangular potato, beet and pasture fields are crossed by windbreak rows and dairy barns, and mixed forest holds the hills between the big flattened basins.

id-java.fieldEdges: banded rice terraces stacking on volcano slopes with bamboo clumps
id-java.note: Volcano cones drain through radial rice terraces, bamboo-grove homesteads line every lane and teak stands thin out toward the drier east.

it-tuscany.fieldEdges: olive dots and vine rows contouring every slope with cypresses at farm gates
it-tuscany.note: A tapestry of yellow-green sunflower blocks, silver-grey olive terracing and dark vine rows around ochre hill towns; woodlot belts occupy the crest and river bottoms.

gr-cyclades.fieldEdges: dry-stone terrace walls zig-zagging every treeless slope
gr-cyclades.note: Bare brown islands stitched with narrow stone terrace nets where a few stunted olives and vines hide from the wind and bleach-white cubes of villages sit at the harbours.

ma-rif.fieldEdges: hand-stepped plots climbing every steep valley side
ma-rif.note: Smallholder terraces hug the mountain flanks, patching kif fields, barley and olives on steep red soil, while cedar and fir stand as dark caps on the higher ridge tops.

ma-saharan-oases.fieldEdges: walled palm orchard rings on surrounding sand
ma-saharan-oases.note: Date-palm canopies shade three-storey vegetable gardens inside walled groves in valleys, and all around is chocolate-dark hamada, dune belts and dry valleys without green.

om-oman.fieldEdges: aflaj ladder channels feeding stone sand terraces
om-oman.note: Fan-shaped date-palm oasis ladders run down canyon floors at Aflaj springs, terraced fruit and rose gardens climb canal walls on oases mountains, and all else is bare rock and iron gravel.

ir-central-plateau.fieldEdges: qanat-fed strips of green in pale desert
ir-central-plateau.note: Mud-brick villages, pomegranate and garden plots and thin green strips stack along qanat water lines in a dusty grey-tan desert, separated by salt-flat kavir.

in-kerala.fieldEdges: coconut-lined paddy bunds and shaded homestead gardens
in-kerala.note: Rice paddies fill the valley bottoms under coconut palms, homestead compounds sit inside shaded gardens, and rubber and tea paint the Ghats slopes near-continuous dark green.

ma-atlas-middle-atlas.fieldEdges: open cedar-wood pasture mosaic with shepherd trails
ma-atlas-middle-atlas.note: Cedar and holm-oak woods open into grazed savannah woodland with shepherd camps on the green plateaus, and dry southern slopes only carry scattered juniper.

ma-atlantic-plains.fieldEdges: flat cereal and citrus fields broken by eucalypt windbreak rows
ma-atlantic-plains.note: Golden wheat and barley plains dotted with orange groves and dark green eucalyptus single-row windbreaks, with Argan scrub woods covering the dry southwest.

sa-hejaz-asir.fieldEdges: stone-faced terrace walls stepping the mountain flanks
sa-hejaz-asir.note: Highland terraces are stacked narrow stone walls on the narrow wet side of the most precipitous mountains, planted with coffee and wheat in green plots, while juniper stands hold the cloud crests and the Hejaz slopes are bare sandy backdrops.

sa-najd-interior.fieldEdges: irrigated pivot dots, fenced sand plots and dry wadi gravel
sa-najd-interior.note: Extremely arid gravel plains with wadis of desert acacia and palm rows around historic mudbrick towns; modern green dots on the oasis sand are in small concentrations only.

sa-eastern-province.fieldEdges: dune-flank shrub margins and palm-compound walls around irrigated plots
sa-eastern-province.note: A pale sand sea spanning the Rubʿ al-Khali and Ad-Dahna, broken only by the dark-green block of Al-Ahsa’s two-million-palm oasis, alfalfa pivots and the grey Dammam-Jubail industrial coast.

ir-caspian-coast.fieldEdges: tea terraces and rice paddies packed on the wet narrow plain
ir-caspian-coast.note: The wettest corner of Iran shows dark green tea patches and flooded rice paddies mosaicked between houses, and the humid Hyrcanian forest climbs the Alborz foothills above the paddies.

ir-zagros.fieldEdges: dry stone walls around orchard terraces and wheat stubble
ir-zagros.note: Degraded oak woodland covers the mountain slopes in scattered patches, and valleys fill with walnut, almond and pistachio orchards behind stone walls between snow-wintered ridges.

tr-anatolian-plateau.fieldEdges: wheat stubble plains with sparse poplar-marked ditches
tr-anatolian-plateau.note: A giant grey-gold steppe plateau of wheat and barley stubble, salt flats, sparse villages and poplar gallery rows visible only along the Kizilirmak.

tr-marmara-thrace.fieldEdges: sunflower and wheat squares behind poplar windbreak rows and hedgerow coppice
tr-marmara-thrace.note: Dark oak-beech forest caps the Istranca, Uludag and Bolu ridges while olive and vineyard rows dress the south Marmara slopes, poplar-lined Thrace squares sit open and the city-factory belt smears the southern shore.

tr-aegean-mediterranean.fieldEdges: grey olive-grove lattices backed by pine-dotted ridges
tr-aegean-mediterranean.note: Silver olive grids and cotton blocks on the plains, fig and citrus strips near the coasts, and the backdrop ridges are covered with maquis and Aleppo pine in dark bands.

eg-nile-valley-delta.fieldEdges: palm-lined irrigation canal banks squared into fields
eg-nile-valley-delta.note: A narrow green vein of palm-franked canals growing cotton, maize and date palms, fanning out into a delta of rice paddies and citrus orchards that is cut off abruptly by bare desert.

pk-punjab-indus.fieldEdges: shisham-lined canal banks above flooded wheat lattices
pk-punjab-indus.note: Canal-irrigated plains read as washed-green wheat, flooded rice and cane blocks, with shisham and eucalyptus lines flanking every channel and mango orchards thickening southward.

ye-yemen.fieldEdges: dry stone terraces climbing every hill and wadi wall
ye-yemen.note: Hand-built terraces ladder the whole escarpment in ochres and greens, qat and coffee alternate with wheat, palms line the wadi floors and dry-stone villages dot the ridges.

jo-jordan.fieldEdges: olive rows on grey steppe terraces and irrigated greenhouses in the rift
jo-jordan.note: Yellow-grey steppe cut by olive rows on cultivated ridges, then a sudden ribbon of subtropical vegetable fields and palms along the Jordan Valley bottoms.

il-ps-israel-palestine.fieldEdges: drip-irrigated orchard blocks, olive hill terraces and cypress screen woods
il-ps-israel-palestine.note: A green coastal plain and Galilean hills of drip-irrigated orchards and winter field strips; the West Bank's stony hills are wrapped in stepped olive terraces.

lb-sy-lebanon-syria.fieldEdges: stone terraces and orchard rows on every flank with cedar summit clumps
lb-sy-lebanon-syria.note: Mount Lebanon's flank shows century-old hillside terraces of vine and olive with cedar clumps near the summit snowline, and Syria dries eastward into olive grids and rain-fed wheat steppe.

iq-mesopotamian-plains.fieldEdges: date-palm rows shepherding irrigation ditches between fields
iq-mesopotamian-plains.note: Flat alluvial tan-brown silt land is only green along Tigris and Euphrates channels, dense date-palm stands line the ditches and hide the villages, and reed marsh spreads across the flooded south.

iq-ir-kurdistan-highlands.fieldEdges: walled orchard gardens on dry stone stream terraces
iq-ir-kurdistan-highlands.note: Open oak woodland covers the slopes in scattered stands, spring-fed valleys fill with walnut and pomegranate orchards, and dry-stone villages overlook the higher meadows.

af-afghanistan.fieldEdges: poplar rows flanking irrigation ditches in grey-brown desert
af-afghanistan.note: Intense green belts of poppy, wheat, pomegranate and walnut follow the rivers and karez lines, stepping off abruptly into grey badlands and bare ridges.

tm-uz-tj-lowlands.fieldEdges: straight canal-belted cotton fields with poplar windbreak rows
tm-uz-tj-lowlands.note: An immense irrigated cotton belt whose canals are traced by poplar and mulberry shelterbelt lines, entirely surrounded by the grey sands of the Karakum.

ge-am-az-caucasus.fieldEdges: vineyard rows and walnut orchards downstream from forested slopes
ge-am-az-caucasus.note: Continuous forest covers the Colchis foothills with tea gardens underneath in western Georgia, vine rows trace the south-facing slopes, and walnut orchards and grain terraces climb toward alpine meadows.

in-rajasthan-thar.fieldEdges: khejri tree clumps, wind-blown sand ridges and canal-fed green strips
in-rajasthan-thar.note: An ochre dune sea broken by scattered millet plots and khejri tree clumps, with the Indira Gandhi Canal drawing emerald strips through the western border zone.

in-indo-gangetic-plain.fieldEdges: bunded sugarcane and rice-to-wheat grids crossed by canal lines
in-indo-gangetic-plain.note: A seamless emerald sheet of cane blocks, wheat-then-rice rotations and eucalyptus trees planted straight along every road, bund and rail line.

in-deccan-plateau.fieldEdges: bunded millet and cotton squares with thorn tree clumps
in-deccan-plateau.note: Big dry squares of sorghum and cotton in brown-red earth with thorn clumps left standing, and dark teak patches along the hill margins.

in-tamil-nadu-coast.fieldEdges: paddy-delta squares laced with straight coconut rows and casuarina belts
in-tamil-nadu-coast.note: Coconut fronds flood the Cauvery deltas above dark-wet rice squares, casuarina belts cut every coastal field, and white salt pans flash along the southern coast.

in-himalaya-kashmir-ladakh.fieldEdges: poplar rows lining canal-fed orchard terraces
in-himalaya-kashmir-ladakh.note: Kashmir's wide valley reads as an orchard carpet under Chinar and deodar slopes, while Ladakh's cliffs stay bare except narrow glacier-fed barley strips enclosed in poplar rows.

in-northeast-bengal.fieldEdges: jute-and-rice paddies interlaced with cut bamboo homestead clumps
in-northeast-bengal.note: Paddies and jute blocks stay emerald almost all year, every homestead hides behind bamboo and areca clumps, and Assam's tea rows carpet the Brahmaputra banks.

pk-sindh-balochistan.fieldEdges: flood-irrigated trenching lines and date palm rows in pale dust
pk-sindh-balochistan.note: Dates, sugarcane and mango orchards fill the Indus flood belt, then stop hard against stony Balochistan bajadas where only terrace-fed fruit patches stay green.

pk-northern-mountains.fieldEdges: irrigated terraces switchbacking up valley walls below hanging glaciers
pk-northern-mountains.note: Glacier-fed orchards of apricot, walnut and cherry pack narrow terraces along the valley floors below snow peaks, while everything above turns to glacier snouts, scree and willow stands at the village edges.

np-bt-nepal-bhutan.fieldEdges: stepped rice-and-maize terraces climbing almost every flank
np-bt-nepal-bhutan.note: Mid-hills stack millet and maize terraces steeply on both flanks, forest follows every gully, and farming stops well below the permanent snow line.

bd-bangladesh.fieldEdges: raised homestead mounds and shrimp gher walls between paddy plots
bd-bangladesh.note: A soaked delta grid of rice bunds, jute blocks and tidal shrimp gher squares, with bamboo-and-palm homestead groves covering every raised mound.

lk-mv-sri-lanka-maldives.fieldEdges: clipped tea rows stepping the hill contours behind coconut-dotted paddies
lk-mv-sri-lanka-maldives.note: Clipped emerald tea blocks carpet the central highland slopes, coconut palms ring the paddy lowlands and the dry north holds scattered scrub above irrigation tanks.

cn-north-china-plain.fieldEdges: squared wheat-maize plots with mud-banked paths and poplar wind rows
cn-north-china-plain.note: Winter wheat then maize rotate over enormous dusty-gray-green full flat plains kept only for rows of poplar planted to stop dust storms, with treed village clusters holding small orchards.

cn-yangtze-delta.fieldEdges: a tight grid of paddy cells, fish ponds and mulberry strips cut by concrete-lined canals
cn-yangtze-delta.note: One continuous canal-diced paddy-and-pond mosaic from Shanghai inland, with camphor-and-bamboo villages at every wrist of water and forest only as small hill-and-temple patches.

cn-south-guangdong-guangxi-fujian.fieldEdges: bunded paddy flats on valley floors, hill slopes cut into rice terraces, dry-stone Hakka village margins
cn-south-guangdong-guangxi-fujian.note: Green subtropical hills bristle with stepped rice terraces, lychee-citrus orchards and sugarcane blocks around the near-continuous urban wall of the Pearl River Delta.

cn-sichuan-yunnan.fieldEdges: red-earth basin paddies and rapeseed strips below stacked terraces on the Yunnan slopes
cn-sichuan-yunnan.note: A cloudy, densely farmed basin mosaic in Sichuan gives way in Yunnan to terraces winding in silver bands up the mountains around every hamlet.

cn-tibetan-plateau.fieldEdges: few and pale: barley strips ringed by yak pasture around monastery towns
cn-tibetan-plateau.note: A gigantic tan-buff plateau where almost the only green is highland barley in the south-facing valleys, with poplar-willow river lines and monastery tree clumps below the snow line.

cn-xinjiang-gansu.fieldEdges: cotton and melon plots pinned against dune edges by poplar windbreak lines
cn-xinjiang-gansu.note: Ochre desert basins crossed by narrow, absurdly green oasis strings - grape trellis corridors of Turpan, poplar-lined canals and the Hexi Corridor chain of walled farms.

cn-northeast-inner-mongolia.fieldEdges: kilometre-long maize, soybean and rice rectangles striped by evenly spaced poplar windbreaks
cn-northeast-inner-mongolia.note: Black-soil Manchurian grain fields lie in huge planned rectangles striped by Great Green Wall shelterbelts, with larch-birch forest pushed back to the flanking hills.

mn-mongolia.fieldEdges: almost none: ger camps, horse tracks and salt pans are the only boundaries on open steppe
mn-mongolia.note: Tawny steppe runs to the horizon dotted with white gers, dark larch-pine forest hangs only from northern mountain flanks, and Ulaanbaatar sits as a lone urban smudge.

kr-kp-korea.fieldEdges: mud-bunded paddies pressed tight against the feet of every wooded hill
kr-kp-korea.note: Forested blue-green hills drop straight into tiny emerald rice plains with dark pine ridge crests, and the DMZ leaves an untrodden green stripe across the peninsula.

tw-taiwan.fieldEdges: paddy and cane cells on the west plain, tea terraces and betel rows climbing the foothills
tw-taiwan.note: A dark forested spine splits a glowing green west where rice, sugarcane, betel palms and stepped tea pack every metre below the mountains.

jp-kyushu-shikoku.fieldEdges: tiny bunded paddies in valley huddles, cedar plantations climbing every slope, stone-walled tea steps
jp-kyushu-shikoku.note: Steep cedar-and-camphor islands terrace into tea and mandarin rows facing the Inland Sea, with the dark Aso caldera and forested Shikoku spine dominating the silhouettes.

vn-north-red-river-karst.fieldEdges: delta paddy cells divided by dikes and bamboo lines, paddies wrapping the base of every karst tower
vn-north-red-river-karst.note: Grey-green limestone towers rise straight out of flat emerald paddies near Ha Long and Ninh Binh while the northwest highlands step into fine rice terraces.

vn-centre-south-mekong.fieldEdges: a strict right-angle canal grid over paddy flats with coconut rows along each hamlet and casuarina belts on the coast
vn-centre-south-mekong.note: The Mekong delta is a canal-diced rice-and-orchard garden cut from bank to bank, the central coast runs sandy behind casuarina lines, and the forested Truong Son wall closes the west.

th-thailand.fieldEdges: bunded paddies with scattered cane blocks and temple-pond villages on the plain, terraces stepping the north
th-thailand.note: A wet-season emerald, dry-season stubble quilt of paddies, cane and cassava floats on the Chao Phraya plain with dark rubber hills in the south and stepped terraces in the north.

la-kh-laos-cambodia.fieldEdges: river-bank gardens and slash-and-burn edges with almost no formal field boundaries
la-kh-laos-cambodia.note: Bamboo-and-timber hamlets with thatch and wat roofs dot a roomy mosaic of river-hugging paddy flats and dark forested hills, pocked by cardamom and rubber plots.

mm-myanmar.fieldEdges: palm-diked delta paddies and dry-zone sesame plots scattered like biscuits on sand
mm-myanmar.note: The Irrawaddy delta’s tidal paddies form a palm-studded green lattice against the grey-sand dry zone, while teak-bamboo forests and stilt villages fill the folds.

my-sg-peninsular-malaysia-singapore.fieldEdges: straight estate roads and drain ditches outlining geometric oil-palm blocks
my-sg-peninsular-malaysia-singapore.note: Dark ridged interior rainforest contrasts with endless runted-green oil-palm grids, and kampung strips plus Singapore’s slab towers close the peninsula’s ends.

my-id-bn-borneo.fieldEdges: oil-palm block borders cut straight into black drained peat lines and river strips
my-id-bn-borneo.note: A dense equatorial rainforest blanket of dipterocarps and peat swamp is progressively dented by oil-palm rectangles, milky rivers and burn-scar haze.

id-sumatra.fieldEdges: straight oil-palm and rubber estate ditches astride the equatorial haze belt
id-sumatra.note: The Barisan volcanic spine keeps dark forest along the west flank while the east side drowns in pale-green oil-palm grids and peat-smoke pall.

ph-philippines.fieldEdges: bunded paddies and cane rows climbing into coconut cones on every hill
ph-philippines.note: Thousands of green island cells show coconut-draped volcano rims, terraced paddies and sugar plots between white barrios.

gb-southern-england.fieldEdges: hawthorn hedgerow cells of grass and arable with pollarded willows at the ditches
gb-southern-england.note: The classic bocage of small hedged green cells and beech-yew downland woods is instantly readable, while London fans out in grey terraces and post-war slabs.

gb-north-wales-scotland.fieldEdges: grey drystone-walled sheep cells and heather moor blocks with Sitka rectangles
gb-north-wales-scotland.note: Dark blanket moor and bracken ridges are dotted with rare bright improved fields, giant uniform Sitka spruce plantations and scattered Caledonian pine remnants.

ie-ireland.fieldEdges: small quilt fields of permanent grass woven by hedgerow hawthorn lines
ie-ireland.note: One continuous green bocage blanket in which every field is a hedge-bounded cell, plus dark spruce plantation rectangles and blanket-bog patches in the west.

fr-north.fieldEdges: kilometre-wide beet-cereal squares in the Beauce against small hedged Normandy dairy cells with orchard rows
fr-north.note: Two prints: hedge-bocage dairy country in the west with timber farms and apple rows, and an almost treeless wheat-sugar-beet sea through the Paris basin with faint poplar canal lines.

fr-southwest-massif-central.fieldEdges: straight vineyard lanes and maize plots in the basins, chestnut and walnut stands on the slopes
fr-southwest-massif-central.note: Vineyard street-grids and maize read around the Garonne, maritime-pine plantations carpet the Landes, and grey volcanic lauze roofs mark the dark forested Auvergne uplands.

es-central-plateau.fieldEdges: open cereal-fallow plains with dehesa holm-oak savanna and centre-pivot circles
es-central-plateau.note: Enormous ochre empty plains are picked out by dehesa oak parkland, La Mancha irrigated pivots and fortified hill villages ringed with scant pines.

es-andalusia-mediterranean.fieldEdges: aligned olive rows in their millions plus plastic foil bights at Almeria
es-andalusia-mediterranean.note: Regular olive-grove sheets glaze pale hills around whitewashed hilltop pueblos, while the coast shows resorts and the silver-green plastic-greenhouse sea of Almeria.

pt-portugal.fieldEdges: montado scattered-cork-oak savanna over wheat stubble in the Alentejo, terraces and granite walls in the north
pt-portugal.note: The north stacks eucalypt-pine forest, terraced Douro vineyards and granite hamlets, then the Alentejo unrolls into near-empty montado savanna and giant cereal squares.

it-north.fieldEdges: rectangular maize-wheat-rape beds lined with poplar rows and canals
it-north.note: Europe’s most cultivated plain shows poplar plantation rows, flood-silver paddies around Vercelli and hill vineyards, with the conifer-dark Alps gripping the northern edge.

it-south-sicily.fieldEdges: durum-wheat ridges with olive, citrus and almond terraces wrapping the hill towns
it-south-sicily.note: Cross-hatched durum hills studded with aligned olive and citrus terraces carry ochre hilltop towns, while Etna’s black lava slopes bristle with vine rows.

id-sulawesi-maluku.fieldEdges: coconut rings around every hamlet, clove and nutmeg stands on the slopes
id-sulawesi-maluku.note: Rainforest mantles the K-shaped island’s arms and the scattered spice islands, with terraced Minahasa paddies and stilt fishing villages above turquoise inlets.

id-nusa-tenggara-timor-leste.fieldEdges: dry maize-savanna sweeps with palm clumps and terraced wet pockets in the valleys
id-nusa-tenggara-timor-leste.note: Dry monsoon country: tan savanna hills sprinkled with lontar palms, green rice pockets wedged into valleys, and volcano-cone terraces from Flores to Timor.

pg-id-new-guinea.fieldEdges: highland garden clearings and sago swamp edges with almost no formal boundaries
pg-id-new-guinea.note: A basin-scale unbroken rainforest blanket sewn by long brown rivers, with the highlands stepped into sweet-potato garden mosaics and scattered stilt hamlets.

au-east-coast.fieldEdges: cane blocks and orchard rows on the coastal flats, cleared ridges against blue-grey eucalypt gullies
au-east-coast.note: A narrow settled ribbon of cane and horticulture from Burdekin to Bundaberg runs under the forested Great Dividing Range, where rainforest gullies cap the eucalypt slopes.

au-interior-outback.fieldEdges: wire paddock fences and bore drains on endless red mulga-spinifex flats
au-interior-outback.note: Vivid red-orange country with mulga scrub ledges, salt-lake flashes and lone windmill-bore circles, so empty that boundaries read only where fences run straight.

au-southwest-tasmania.fieldEdges: vine rows in the Margaret River valleys, apple orchards in the Huon, straight plantation edges
au-southwest-tasmania.note: Jarrah-karri forest and vineyard valleys fill the fertile south-west while Tasmania reads as a plantation-and-dairy green quilt hugging an untouched wild southwest.

nz-north-island.fieldEdges: open paddock cross-fences, radiata woodlots and kiwifruit mazes in the Bay of Plenty
nz-north-island.note: Brilliant-green dairy paddocks wrap the volcanic cones of Taranaki and Ruapehu, with dark kauri-bush hangovers on the ranges and geothermal cloud or smoke plumes rising freely.

nz-south-island.fieldEdges: hedge-and-willow-lined paddocks, giant centre-pivots on the Canterbury plain, vine mazes in Marlborough
nz-south-island.note: A hard split: dark beech rainforest and fiords west of the Southern Alps, then glowing pasture with massive pivots, braided rivers and glacier-touched blue lakes east.

fj-ws-to-pf-pacific-islands.fieldEdges: coconut plantation rows, taro pond patches and stone village enclosures
fj-ws-to-pf-pacific-islands.note: Volcanic islands wear a coconut-green skirt with taro swamp beds and breadfruit groves packed around beach villages, while blue lagoons fringe everything.

us-hawaii.fieldEdges: old sugar-cane furrows and macadamia blocks lining the leeward coasts
us-hawaii.note: Shield-volcano islands are rainfall-zoned: deep-green ohia-koa forest windward, old cane and pineapple fields leeward, and Kona coffee terracing Mauna Loa’s flanks.

de-north.fieldEdges: big beet-rape-cereal blocks with straight margins, poplar rows on the geest sand
de-north.note: A flat glacial plain: mega open arable east of the Elbe, pine-birch geest and heath wedges, and a north-west of tiny dairy cells, pollards and canal dikes.

de-south.fieldEdges: Streuobst meadow-orchards ringing the villages, vine terraces on the Rhine and Kaiserstuhl
de-south.note: Nucleated red-tile villages sit in a maize-and-meadow mosaic between the dark spruce slab of the Black Forest, the Hallertau hop lattice and steep hillside vineyards.

be-lux.fieldEdges: tiny hedged arable-pasture cells in Flanders, open Hesbaye grain inland, Moselle vine terraces
be-lux.note: One of Europe’s densest rural mosaics - brick ribbon villages, hedge-woven green cells and poplar canal lines - gives way to the dark forested Ardennes plateau in the southeast.

ch-at.fieldEdges: striped hay-meadow mosaics pinned between the slopes, slim orchard lines on valley floors
ch-at.note: Grey rock and snowfields overhang dark spruce, stepped bright hay meadows and chalet villages fold into every valley, and the treeline caps everything ruthlessly.

dk.fieldEdges: planted windbreak tree rows bounding almost every farm holding since the 1860s
dk.note: A rolling moraine quilt of rape-yellow and grain fields stitched by dark windbreak rows around every holding, with brick-red farmsteads and an island scatter.

se-south.fieldEdges: big rape-wheat-beet fields crossed by poplar and oak avenues, lake-and-boulder woods in Smaland
se-south.note: The Skane plain is an open yellow-green field quilt sliced by poplar-oak avenues, while beech woods and lake-studded forest chew the Smaland highlands.

se-north-fi.fieldEdges: lakeside hay and barley strips, straight forest tracks, bogs between
se-north-fi.note: One dark blue-green taiga blanket stitched by thousands of smooth lakes with straight spruce foreshores, and regular pale clear-cut squares regrowing like plaid patches.

is.fieldEdges: monochrome moss-lava desert with only fenced fertilised hay rings around the farmsteads
is.note: A silver-grey basaltic island with essentially no trees beyond birch scrub, lightened only by bright hayfield rectangles at each farm and steam-white geothermal smudges.

pl.fieldEdges: impossibly fine 1-4 ha strip fields radiating off every lane, apple orchard rows and pine plantation blocks
pl.note: Fragmentation defines it: a fine grey-green-brown quilt of narrow strips with roadside avenues, rape-yellow squares scattered among dark square plantations and busy county towns.

cz-sk-hu.fieldEdges: straight strip fields and maize-alfalfa blocks against wood edges, locust-poplar windbreak rows
cz-sk-hu.note: A sea of small red-tile roofs under cream church spires nests in wooded Bohemian-Moravian hills, the Danube lowlands open into giant sunflower-maize squares and Carpathian spruce folds edge the east.

dz-tn-tell.fieldEdges: wheat and vine strips below olive terraces on the coastal folds
dz-tn-tell.note: White cubical houses hang on the Mediterranean-facing slopes above banded olive and cork-oak woods, while wheat fills the smooth valley floors between the ridge lines.

dz-ly-ne-ml-mr-sahara.fieldEdges: oasis garden walls and palm clusters, nothing between erg edges
dz-ly-ne-ml-mr-sahara.note: Hyper-arid nothingness: pale erg sand seas, hamada gravel sheets and black wadi scars, with green palm-garden dots at every spring between the dunes.

ly-coast.fieldEdges: dry-wall olive and fig plots over the stony pre-desert flats
ly-coast.note: A white-concrete coastal strip around Tripoli and Benghazi sits caught between olive-fig garden blocks and the empty stony pre-desert behind.

sd-ss-sudan-south-sudan.fieldEdges: mechanised sorghum and cotton squares on the clay plain, invisible grazing range lines
sd-ss-sudan-south-sudan.note: A blue-green Nile ribbon with irrigated cotton schemes runs between dun acacia steppe, ending in the vast papyrus sponge of the Sudd swamps to the south.

et-highlands.fieldEdges: hand-built bunded terraces wrapping every ridge, eucalypt fence lines
et-highlands.note: A green, tightly terraced mountain quilt in which every slope is bunded by hand under teff and coffee stands, eucalypt fence lines and round tukul villages make the pattern readable.

er-dj-so-horn.fieldEdges: thornbush paddocks and escarpment terraces near the highland edge
er-dj-so-horn.note: An arid thorn-and-frankincense steppe split by long wadis, with Ethiopian escarpment terracing at the west edge and camel-drive dune coasts to the sea.

sn-ml-bf-ne-td-sahel.fieldEdges: dispersed millet and sorghum plots with Faidherbia and baobab trees left standing mid-field
sn-ml-bf-ne-td-sahel.note: A pale grass-and-thornbush sea in which reddish field cells around adobe compounds carry lone standing Faidherbia and baobab trees for shade and fodder.

ci-gh-tg-bj-coast.fieldEdges: straight cocoa stands with cassava inter-stripes, coconut lines on every lagoon sandbar
ci-gh-tg-bj-coast.note: Glossy dark-green cocoa blocks and oil-palm grids blanket the coastal belt down to lagoon-and-dune strips lined with coconut palms behind the surf.

ng-nigeria.fieldEdges: cassava-yam mounds and maize cells tight around every compound, oil-palm clumps on the slopes
ng-nigeria.note: Humid palm-and-cassava farm mosaics in the south grade through brush-fallow savanna to open thorn-farmland in the far north, stitched to the forests by the oil-palm Middle Belt.

gn-sl-lr-guinea-coast.fieldEdges: rice-bush-fallow mosaic with palms marking every old village site
gn-sl-lr-guinea-coast.note: A wet, green bush-and-forest mosaic cracked by tan swidden patches and mangrove-fringed estuaries, with rubber and oil-palm plantings stacked on the Fouta Djallon foothill walls.

gr-mainland-crete.fieldEdges: grey-green olive terraces and tiny wheat-fallow paddies wrapping marble-white slopes
gr-mainland-crete.note: Marble-white rocky slopes stitched with grey olive terraces and tiny wheat-fallow paddies carry white-cube towns from Thessaly to Crete.

balkans-west.fieldEdges: drystone karst walls gridding sheep pasture, vine terraces climbing river gorges
balkans-west.note: Limestone karst walls cut sheep fields into a grey checkerboard behind forested Dinaric ridges, with vine terraces and red-tile towns set in every valley mouth.

balkans-centre.fieldEdges: Vojvodina grain belts and sunflower blocks, plum orchards filling every hill hollow
balkans-centre.note: Flat Vojvodina grain belts and sunflower blocks give way to an oak-plum hill-orchard mosaic with ridge-top pine villages above the Vardar valley floor.

ro-md.fieldEdges: strip villages threading every valley with hay meadows and plum orchards, sunflower steppe opening south
ro-md.note: The Carpathian arc holds dark beech-conifer forest around chain villages and plum orchards, releasing into open sunflower-wheat steppe and slope vineyard belts in Moldova.

bg.fieldEdges: Danube plain grain stripes, rose fields and vineyard belts between the dark spines
bg.note: The forested Stara Planina spine darkens the middle while grain plains spread north to the Danube and the south stacks rose fields, wine terraces and mosaic mountains.

ua.fieldEdges: straight kilometre-long field blocks tied by poplar windbreak rows
ua.note: The greatest straight-line field canvas on Earth: endless wheat, maize and sunflower giant squares stitched by poplar windbreaks with dacha orchard clumps at every village.

by.fieldEdges: small damp strips and potato plots ringed by pine and birch
by.note: A flat pine-birch forest-and-marsh quilt with bog patches speckling the Pripyat basin, and small grain-potato strips pressed against every wood edge.

baltics.fieldEdges: big striped arable blocks with rape-yellow May squares between dark bog-and-forest islands
baltics.note: Big striped arable blocks and rape-yellow spring squares sit between vast spruce-pine-birch forests, raised bogs and smooth glacial lakes.

ru-west.fieldEdges: communal strip fields and dacha orchards against dark wood edges
ru-west.note: The Russian plain prints as a north taiga blanket, a middle forest-steppe mosaic of birch-oak woods with strip fields, and dacha-orchard belts around every village.

cy-mt.fieldEdges: tiny stone-terraced plots with drywall margins, Mesaoria grain flats
cy-mt.note: Stone-grey terraces and drywalled olive-carob plots mark both islands: Malta merges into one dense limestone sprawl while Cyprus opens Mesaoria grain flats below the Troodos pines.

cm-cf.fieldEdges: cocoa-under-forest plots and oil-palm estate grids, then savanna compound farms to the north
cm-cf.note: A rainforest-to-savanna ladder: cocoa-shaded forest in the south, palm-and-maize farms on the Cameroon line volcanoes, and Sahelian compound fields on the edge.

cd-cg-ga-gq-congo-basin.fieldEdges: cassava-plantain garden clearings and raffia swamp lines, no fences
cd-cg-ga-gq-congo-basin.note: The world’s second-largest tropical forest appears as one unbroken green canopy mass threaded by the Congo’s broad brown loops and swampy raffia channels.

ug-uganda.fieldEdges: banana-shaded coffee garden plots wrapping every volcanic and lake-shore hill
ug-uganda.note: Fertile equatorial lake-land where banana-shaded coffee gardens and eucalypt stands quilt every hill around Lake Victoria with hardly a straight field in view.

rw-bi.fieldEdges: hill-to-hill terraces shoulder to shoulder with tea slope blocks
rw-bi.note: The thousand-hills highlands read as one continuous fine-grain terrace quilt ridge to ridge, with tea and coffee bands and only the papyrus swamps as gaps.

tz-tanzania.fieldEdges: maize-banana homestead cells in the north, coconut-cashew groves east, open miombo elsewhere
tz-tanzania.note: Big open savanna plains with acacia-baobab scatter, dense miombo woodland to the west and south, coconut-clove groves along the coast and Kilimanjaro’s cone overhead.

ke-coast.fieldEdges: coconut-cashew groves in straight rows behind mangrove-lined creeks
ke-coast.note: A palm-and-cashew coastal ribbon runs behind mangrove creeks and estuary shallows, ending within 100 kilometres against the drier savanna interior.

ao-angola.fieldEdges: open miombo-and-grass mosaic with scattered compound farm polygons
ao-angola.note: A narrow coastal desert gives way inland to wide miombo woodland and savanna mosaic on the Bie plateau, coffee-palm groves in the humid north and compound farm polygons on the plateau.

zm-mw.fieldEdges: maize-mound homestead cells with tobacco curing barns between woodland islands
zm-mw.note: A big miombo plateau sea of bronze-green canopy between compound maize fields and tobacco barns, split by the blue gash of Lake Malawi and the bends of the Zambezi.

mz-mozambique.fieldEdges: cashew-coconut groves threading the coast with flooded paddies inland
mz-mozambique.note: A long palm-and-mangrove Indian Ocean coast with cashew-and-coconut groves steps inland through open savanna, split by the Zambezi’s giant delta fan.

zw-zimbabwe.fieldEdges: Highveld maize-tobacco-barn farm blocks with msasa woodland gullies between
zw-zimbabwe.note: Highveld maize-and-tobacco farm blocks with msasa woodland gullies knit the plateau, thorn scrub sinks toward the Limpopo lowveld and the misted Eastern Highlands close the east.

ru-north.fieldEdges: hay swathes on river terraces, the rest one endless bog-taiga horizon
ru-north.note: One dark spruce-pine-birch taiga blanket over glacial lake-and-bog country broken only by hay meadows flanking brown braided rivers, timber-cut squares and reed-gold deltas.

ru-south.fieldEdges: giant straight wheat-sunflower fields striped by poplar-locust shelterbelts, long-street stanitsa villages
ru-south.note: The black-earth steppe prints as gigantic striped grain-and-sunflower rectangles stitched by poplar-locust shelterbelts, with the snow white Caucasus wall and vineyard-terraced Kuban belt at the southern edge.

ru-caucasus.fieldEdges: vineyard bench terraces and maize plots on the foothill fans below the snow wall
ru-caucasus.note: Open Stavropol grain plains abut an abrupt snowy Caucasus wall of hornbeam-oak forest, vineyard bench terraces at their feet and mountain-valley town clusters beneath.

ru-urals.fieldEdges: forest edge meeting the spring-wheat steppe state east of the crest
ru-urals.note: A low, densely forested ridge of fir, birch and pine rolls between steppe farmland on both slopes, marked by a chain of smoke-stacked industrial cities along the slope.

ru-w-sib.fieldEdges: grain mega-fields in the Kulunda steppe south, bog-taiga sponge north
ru-w-sib.note: A bog-and-cedar taiga sponge with slow brown river loops and oil-gas pads in the north gives way at the south edge to Kulunda’s immense straight spring-wheat fields and ribbon pine bars.

ru-e-sib.fieldEdges: small hay-oat valley pockets and alas grassland rings in the permafrost plains
ru-e-sib.note: A single cold larch taiga mass on permafrost stretches horizon to horizon, broken only by river-valley hay meadows, alas grassland rings and the blue crack of Baikal.

ru-far-east.fieldEdges: soybean squares around southern valley towns, berry-bog marshes to the north
ru-far-east.note: Korean-pine and Mongolian-oak mixed forest rolls from the Sikhote-Alin range down to a jagged cold sea coast, with tan soybean squares hugging the Amur valley settlements.

kz.fieldEdges: vast straight-bounded spring-wheat blocks in the north, striped cotton belts in the south
kz.note: A near-treeless grass ocean of feather-grass silver-gold rolls into bare uplands, with only windbreak rows along the wheat-belt roads and Schrenk spruce pinned to the southern mountain slopes.

kg.fieldEdges: narrow hay-potato plots pinned between range walls, walnut-fruit groves in the south valleys
kg.note: Deep green Schrenk spruce hangs on every Tian Shan slope while hay meadows fill valley floors and walnut-fruit groves thicken the Fergana-edge valleys.

micro.fieldEdges: terraced gardens and hay terraces behind slate village walls
micro.note: Four microstates read in close-up: Andorra’s slate-roofed valley terraces under dark Pyrenean pine, Monaco’s apartment wall on the Riviera, and San Marino’s and the Vatican’s fortress-hill and urban microcosms.

ru-gaps.fieldEdges: forest-steppe strip fields and steppe grain between taiga north and mountain basins
ru-gaps.note: A catch-all of leftover federal subjects: forest-steppe strip fields in Kurgan, coal-scarred taiga in Kemerovo, Tuva’s steppe-and-larch mountain basins, and soy-and-taiga squares along the Amur bend.

br-amazon.fieldEdges: fishbone clear-cut paths and pasture polygons dissolving the canopy edges
br-amazon.note: One unbroken green canopy mass, gnawed at its edges by fishbone cleared pasture polygons and burn-scar fields along every road, with grey-brown river braids the only other shape.

br-northeast.fieldEdges: green sugar-cane blocks on the wet coast, bean-cassava plots inland, thorn caatinga between
br-northeast.note: Three stacked prints: a green sugar-cane coastal strip, the seasonally brown caatinga thorn mosaic inland with cacti and carnauba palms, and the agreste highland pasture belt between.

br-se-south.fieldEdges: coffee strung on ridges, sugar-cane blocks, straight plantation rows
br-se-south.note: A quilt of coffee-and-cane hillsides with dark araucaria crowns and eucalypt plantation grids, red-soil soy-and-maize flats to the south, and remnant Atlantic rainforest ribs clinging in state parks.

andes-north.fieldEdges: coffee shade-mosaics on steep Andean slopes, llanos palm-savanna below
andes-north.note: A cordillera-in-canopy: shaded coffee farms and cloud-forest gullies on every slope, eucalypt dots around towns and the flat palm-savanna llanos rolling east.

bo.fieldEdges: altiplano strip-terraced plots and Chaco thorn mosaic
bo.note: A triple stack: treeless tan altiplano with strip-terraced potato-quinoa plots and salt flats, green terraced Yungas, and thorn-quebracho Chaco lowland to the east.

cl.fieldEdges: vineyard straight-rows in the central valleys, radiata pine plantation grids in the south
cl.note: A 4,300-kilometre ribbon goes from treeless Atacama gravel through matorral-and-vineyard central valleys to lakes, radiata plantations and fiord forest in the wet south.

ar-pampas.fieldEdges: soy-maize mega-fields edged by eucalypt windbreak rows, shelterbelts the only woody lines
ar-pampas.note: A flat green-gold grassland quilt of enormous soy-maize-wheat blocks edged by lone eucalypt windbreak rows and dotted with small grain-elevator towns.

ar-nw-patagonia.fieldEdges: high-altitude vine terrace rows and sheep-station paddocks of the steppe
ar-nw-patagonia.note: Cactus-algarrobo desert and yungas cloud forest edge the northwest, high-altitude vineyards stair the valleys and lenga-coihue beech forest fringes the windswept Patagonian steppe.

py-uy-guianas.fieldEdges: cattle paddocks on rolling campos, rice squares on the wet coastal plain, thorn Chaco clear-cut edges
py-uy-guianas.note: Paraguay sits in flat dry thorn Chaco country, Uruguay prints as open rolling grass sea with palm groves, and the Guianas add one dark rainforest curtain to a mangrove-fringed rice coast.

za-wc.fieldEdges: vineyard straight-rows against fynbos-clad mountain flanks, oak-lined Cape Dutch avenues
za-wc.note: Mediterranean squares of vines, apples and wheat fill a grey-green fynbos shrubland belt in the Cape Floral Kingdom, with famous oak avenues shading the old estates.

za-hv.fieldEdges: maize-sunflower squares and gold mine-dump rings on open grassveld
za-hv.note: Rolling maize-and-sunflower grassveld at 1,500 metres dotted with eucalypt clumps, gold mine-dump rings and jacaranda-purple towns, with almost no wild forest left.

za-kzn.fieldEdges: cane blocks and burning stubble to the surf, reedbeds and mangrove in the estuaries
za-kzn.note: Mile-wide cane blocks with banana and mango strips run to Indian Ocean surf lines, wetland reedbeds and fever-tree estuaries threading between them.

na-namibia.fieldEdges: irrigation circles and palm-oasis edges against bare gravel plains and dune seas
na-namibia.note: Almost nothing grows unaided: Namib dune seas and gravel plains press a thin ribbon of camelthorn riverbeds, quiver-tree koppies and green irrigation circles.

bw-botswana.fieldEdges: cattle-post clearings ringed with thorn fences, sorghum rows at village edges
bw-botswana.note: Flat red Kalahari sand country with mopane woodland patches, the great green Okavango delta pressing north and cattle posts marking every thorn-bush horizon.

ls-sz.fieldEdges: stone-walled field ladders on Maloti slopes, sugarcane estate grids on the lowveld
ls-sz.note: Treeless Lesotho highlands stack stone-walled fields and rondavel villages under Maluti snow, while green Eswatini adds sugar estates and savanna woodlands.

mg-madagascar.fieldEdges: paddy bunds closing every valley floor, ravinala palms and zebu kraals at village edges
mg-madagascar.note: A quilted island: humid rainforest spine and baobab-studded savannas wrapped around tightly terraced rice valleys in the central highlands.

mu-re-sc.fieldEdges: cane blocks climbing every volcano flank, filao lines behind the beaches
mu-re-sc.note: Sugarcane blankets Mauritius and Réunion island volcanoes to their crater rims, filao casuarina lines hold the beach sands and native forest hides on the highest ridges.

km-yt.fieldEdges: spice and vanilla garden mosaics on volcano slopes, coconut groves to the reefs
km-yt.note: Vanilla, ylang-ylang and banana garden mosaics stack up Comoro volcano slopes, Mayotte's lagoons rimmed with grey-green mangrove.

cv-st.fieldEdges: stone-walled dry terraces on arid slopes, cocoa under tall rainforest shade
cv-st.note: Bare brown Cape Verde islands raise stone-walled dry terraces above palm arrays, while São Tomé's old cocoa roças hide under near-continuous equatorial rainforest.

sb-vu.fieldEdges: coconut plantation rows behind white beach lines, swidden garden patches cut into jungle
sb-vu.note: Deep green Melanesian jungle smothers volcanic islands and reef coasts alike, broken only by swidden gardens, coconut rows and mangrove-lined turquoise lagoons.

nc-wf.fieldEdges: red mining scars and silver niaouli scrub, cattle paddocks on the dry west plain
nc-wf.note: Nickel mining strips red scars through New Caledonia's niaouli scrub and burnt maquis, with a huge reef-ringed lagoon and quiet Wallis crater-lake gardens.

fm-pw-mh-nr-ki-micronesia.fieldEdges: breadfruit-taro village groves inside palm islets, nothing beyond reef flats
fm-pw-mh-nr-ki-micronesia.note: Coral atoll rings and islets slung along reef rims wrap pale lagoons, Palau's jungle-covered Rock Islands being the one compact forest mass.

gu-mp.fieldEdges: taro plots and limestone jungle edges, resort lawns opening onto Tumon Bay
gu-mp.note: A hard volcanic arc: limestone jungle and typhoon-cleared thickets over Guam and the Northern Marianas, with ironwood avenues and flame trees marking each town.

ck-nu-tk-tv-as-pn-polynesia.fieldEdges: pandanus and breadfruit stands beside reef-edge villages, coconut lines on motu rims
ck-nu-tk-tv-as-pn-polynesia.note: Green volcanic cones and palm-veiled atolls alternate from Rarotonga to Tuvalu, bands of taro pits and breadfruit groves hugging every reef-edge village.

hk-mo.fieldEdges: no open field edge, towers rising straight off reclamation water and terraced hillside cemeteries
hk-mo.note: Tower walls of flats and offices ride every steep green slope around a concrete reclamation core, with banyan walls, bamboo scaffolding groves and tiny terraced vegetable plots. (Claude: forestPattern set to large patches; Hong Kong country parks cover about 40% of the land.)

br-cerrado.fieldEdges: central-pivot circles and straight soy squares against twisted cerrado scrub
br-cerrado.note: Giant flat red-soil fields in perfect pivot circles and straight soy squares cut into twisted cerrado savanna trees, dark gallery forest shading every stream.

br-pantanal.fieldEdges: open flood savanna with cattle trails and termite mounds, gallery forest lines along rivers
br-pantanal.note: A gigantic shallow dish flooded half the year: grass and carandá palm savanna with wild cattle that wade across wetland channels, gallery forest lining the river loops.

ar-litoral.fieldEdges: yerba rows under shade trees on red earth, rice paddies in Corrientes lowlands
ar-litoral.note: Argentina's green northeast wedge grows shade-grown yerba mate and tea plantations on red Misiones earth, with Paraná pines and yatay palm savannas rounding the lowlands.

fk.fieldEdges: stock fences crossing whitegrass moor, stone runs and bare fell sides
fk.note: Treeless, wind-scoured whitegrass moor grazed by hardy sheep, cut by stone runs and kelp-brown sea sounds.

gm-gw.fieldEdges: cashew orchards ringed around every compound, swamp rice in tidal flats
gm-gw.note: A slim tidal river country: the mangrove-fringed Gambia estuary lined with groundnut fields opens into Guinea-Bissau's cashew orchard mosaic and palm savanna.

eh.fieldEdges: greenhouse arcs on the Dakhla coast and palm lines inside oasis walls
eh.note: Monotonous desert split by a sand berm wall, phosphate conveyor scars near Laayoune and tomato greenhouse rows lining the Dakhla shore.

gl.fieldEdges: sheep fences among dwarf willow scrub and hay plots in the southern fjords
gl.note: An ice-sheet world with bare nunataks and skerries, green only at the southern fjord mouths where Kujataa sheep farms continue Norse and Inuit farming.

fo-sj.fieldEdges: turf-roofed hay meadows and stone sheep fanks under bird cliffs
fo-sj.note: Green treeless Faroese grass and stone sheep fanks under bird cliffs, while Arctic Svalbard adds bare permafrost tundra and coal-town gravel, both with almost no farming of any kind.

crown-gib.fieldEdges: glasshouse belts and Jersey Royal potato plots, dry-stone pasture walls
crown-gib.note: Four tiny territories in one block: Gibraltar's limestone Upper Rock with olives and candytuft, the Isle of Man's pine-and-beech glens, and hedged dairy-and-glasshouse island farms on Jersey and Guernsey.

gt-bz.fieldEdges: steep milpa corn slopes, coastal cane and banana squares below cloud forest
gt-bz.note: Volcanic highlands terraced with maize milpa patches rise to cloud forest, while Belize adds coastal sugar cane squares, citrus-and-banana belts and reef cayes.

hn-sv-ni.fieldEdges: banana-and-pineapple estate blocks on the coastal plain, tiny coffee plots on slopes
hn-sv-ni.note: Dense El Salvador packs coffee slopes and patch fields wall-to-wall, Honduras adds banana-and-pineapple coastal estates and pine ridges, and Nicaragua sweeps in wet rainforest and volcanic lake country.

cr-pa.fieldEdges: coffee fincas on volcano slopes, banana shipping squares and cattle paddocks
cr-pa.note: Two green isthmus nations: Costa Rica's cloud forests, coffee fincas and banana estates between volcano walls, and Panama's canal-zone settlements ending in the roadless Darién rainforest.

cu.fieldEdges: cane squares with burning stubble, palm-dotted cattle pasture boundaries
cu.note: A long flat limestone island of soft greens where royal palms sentinel every cattle pasture, tobacco fields press into Vuelta Abajo and mogote knolls rise from Viñales jungle.

hispaniola.fieldEdges: cane-rice-cacao mosaics east of a bare, eroded Haitian border line
hispaniola.note: One island, two prints: Dominican pine forest and cane-rice-cacao mosaics meet a Haitian border line where charcoal-driven deforestation leaves brown erosion scars.

jm-ky.fieldEdges: cane blocks on coastal plains, coffee gardens up the Blue Mountain valleys
jm-ky.note: Jamaica's bumpy cockpit karst and cane plains climb to Blue Mountain coffee shade gardens, with flat Cayman mangrove-and-coral banks offshore to the west.

pr-vi-vg.fieldEdges: plantain groves and hillside pasture, mangrove channels behind beach flats
pr-vi-vg.note: Suburban mosaics and plantain groves pack Puerto Rico under the misty El Yunque rainforest canopy, with quiet Virgin Islands veiled in thorn scrub, sea grape and mangrove channels.

less-ant-north.fieldEdges: banana-and-cane patches on volcano slopes, dry scrub and salt ponds in the lees
less-ant-north.note: A nine-island hopping line where rainforest volcano domes like Basse-Terre and Dominica contrast with dry acacia-and-salt-pond Anguilla and Antigua flats.

less-ant-south.fieldEdges: cane blocks rolling to the sea, nutmeg-and-cocoa groves on Grenada hills
less-ant-south.note: Sugarcane presses Barbados and Martinique plantations right to the water line, Grenada stacks nutmeg-and-cocoa groves in rainforest, and Trinidad adds the Caroni mangrove swamp belt.

bs-tc-bm.fieldEdges: blue-hole-dotted pine flats, row-crop garden plots near Nassau
bs-tc-bm.note: Barely-above-sea coral banks where turquoise-to-ivory water gradients make the map, dark Caribbean pine stands on Andros and Grand Bahama, mangrove creeks and casuarina windbreaks everywhere.

dutch-caribbean.fieldEdges: aloe rows and salt pans, thorn-and-cactus brush running to the sea
dutch-caribbean.note: Sun-baked flat islands where divi-divi trees lean permanently seaward, thorn-and-cactus brush covers abandoned plantation grids and Willemstad's pastel warehouses jam Curaçao's Schottegat inlet.

ca-atlantic.fieldEdges: red-soil potato stripes on Prince Edward Island, blueberry barrens and hay fields against fir forest
ca-atlantic.note: A cold green Maritime quilt: red-soil potato and hay squares, blueberry barrens, tidy spruce-fir blocks and house-hedged farmsteads under sea fog.

ca-quebec-ontario.fieldEdges: corn-soy checkerboard and orchard rows against maple woodlot edges
ca-quebec-ontario.note: From Toronto to Quebec City the Great Lakes-St Lawrence corridor runs through alternating suburb, soy-and-corn flat, maple woodlot and Niagara orchard, with dark forest filling every north edge.

ca-prairies.fieldEdges: mile-square stubble-and-canola checkerboard with sloughs, poplar bluffs and grain elevators
ca-prairies.note: Flat wheat-and-canola country cut by the mile-square survey grid, farmstead shelterbelts planted against the wind and aspen bluffs marking every coulee and slough.

ca-bc.fieldEdges: orchard-and-vineyard benches above Okanagan lakes, cut-and-planted timber blocks upvalley
ca-bc.note: A wall of dark temperate rainforest on the coast changes through drier pine-and-grass benches inland, Okanagan orchards and vineyards commanding lakeside terraces.

ca-north.fieldEdges: no fields, only tundra tussocks, lichen flats and the tree line snaking south
ca-north.note: Treeless lichened tundra over permafrost, a monochrome of bog brown and grey shield lakes broken by glacier tongues and the odd mine and settlement.

mx-north.fieldEdges: cotton and vegetable squares strung along irrigation canals, bare bajadas between
mx-north.note: Two great deserts fold around dry sierras, woody brush covering red bajadas in every direction, green only in river-canal irrigation oases and the little wine-and-nut valleys.

mx-central.fieldEdges: maguey rows and milpa corn squares climbing volcanic slopes
mx-central.note: A high volcanic belt with snowy Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl dominating fields of maize milpa, maguey agave rows, avocados and jacaranda-purple avenues.

mx-south.fieldEdges: steep shaded coffee slopes, milpa patches and palm groves down coastal plains
mx-south.note: Green mountains fall to both coasts, dense highland coffee and cacao under shade, hot lowland banana groves and the famous Tehuano wind roaring over the Isthmus of Tehuantepec.

mx-yucatan.fieldEdges: milpa clearings slowly regrowing bush, henequen rows on old hacienda stone walls
mx-yucatan.note: Flat low jungle on porous limestone with no surface rivers, cenote dots marking hidden water, colonial towns ringed by ceibas and henequen rows.

remote-islands.fieldEdges: palm groves and vegetable plots inside tiny island clearings
remote-islands.note: Ten lonely dots from Saint Helena to Diego Garcia whose small green caps of Norfolk pines, coconut groves and scrub hold station life, runway pads and unique seabird colonies.

antarctica.fieldEdges: no fields at all, ice-sheet and nunatak edges and gravel pads around stations
antarctica.note: An ice world with no agriculture: white ice shelves and blue crevasse fields against frost-shattered nunatak ridges and grey research-station gravel flats.

us-mid-atlantic.fieldEdges: suburb-lawn mosaics and horse-pasture fences against oak-hickory ridge lines
us-mid-atlantic.note: From Boston to Washington the land prints as endless grey-brown suburb with office parks, while Finger Lakes vineyards, Lancaster horse pastures and Virginia orchards fill the leftover farmland.

us-southeast.fieldEdges: row-planted loblolly pine over red clay, cotton squares with white boll lint at edges
us-southeast.note: An ocean of straight-planted loblolly pine timber covers rolling red clay, broken by flat cotton and soy fields, kudzu-smothered slopes and dark cypress-tupelo swamp at each river.

us-midwest.fieldEdges: corn-soy quarter-section chessboard with drainage ditches and farm groves
us-midwest.note: The purest Corn Belt on Earth: flawlessly straight corn and soy rows to every horizon, tidy farmhouse groves, grain elevators and bumpier northern lake-and-bog forest at the rim.

us-plains-tx.fieldEdges: pivot circle ends buried in stubble, unwatered corners of the mile grid
us-plains-tx.note: The widest straight grid on Earth: mile-square wheat and stubble rectangles sprinkled with center-pivot circles, Dust Bowl shelterbelt rows and cottonwood lines in every coulee.

us-southwest.fieldEdges: pivot hay circles in sage flats ending squarely against rimrock
us-southwest.note: Red-rock country: layered mesas and Monument Valley buttes over grey-gold sagebrush flats, dark pine-and-fir mountain islands rising above piñon-juniper belts.

us-pacific.fieldEdges: rice levee grids in the Sacramento Valley, walnut-and-almond squares along the valley rim
us-pacific.note: Three coastal stripes: dark fog-draped coast redwood and Douglas-fir forest, golden oak-savanna hills with palms in the cities, and the Central Valley's giant orchard, vineyard and rice grids.

us-alaska.fieldEdges: river gravel bars and muskeg flats, garden patches only at Matanuska
us-alaska.note: A black-and-white spruce taiga quilt with birch-and-aspen slopes, meandering glacial rivers, bog muskeg flats and the Alaska Range's snowy ridgeline cutting through.

green-spain.fieldEdges: eucalypt-edged dairy pastures and maize plots, hay meadows under Atlantic fog
green-spain.note: Along the green Cantabrian coast rain falls nearly every day: small dairy paddocks and maize squares with eucalypt and chestnut shelter rows stack against wet mountain forest.

canaries.fieldEdges: stone terraces holding banana mesh and vine rows on black lava
canaries.note: A volcanic archipelago off West Africa: black and rust lava fields climbing to snow-dusted Teide and pine-coated slopes above terraced banana-and-vine cultures and dragon trees in every plaza.
